Delta requires equal non-input fields and previous full input+actual response items as exact new-input prefix, otherwise full input. Only successful terminal+responseID publishes continuation. One missing-previous-response full retry is allowed before public output; connection-limit before generation starts permits one reconnect, as separate bounded branches. Ordinary WS→SSE only precedes first effective provider event; abort/API/auth/protocol failures never masquerade as transport loss. acceptance_scenarios.scenario: SDK-only public input: **SDK active：** AuthResolver/store/Models；并发近过期、失败、waiter cancel、低层 retry；**host-impact：** 产品恢复. Observable result and failure: 同 prepared logical call 一次解析并冻结 auth；低层 retries 不重新选来源。等待 store-owned 锁的 caller 可取消；**宿主 runtime 存活时，refresh一旦开始仅网络使用独立15s signal，store ACK不受该timer，caller 停止等待不能中断其刷新/原子保存**；Handle 不维持 Runtime 存活，shutdown/abort/timeout/remote或store failure 不保证保存或远端回滚，不冒称旧token仍有效。其他 waiter 复用已提交新 token，不重复 refresh；失败无半凭据/账户 fallback；logout/replace 与刷新同事务序列化，迟到 refresh 不复活已替换身份。取消生成零后续 dispatch，不因已保存刷新自动恢复。显式 V-57 新 call 可重解析同源 auth；产品 recovery identity/持久化政策只属 V-33. Apply all source row evidence boundaries and later backend/RDF refinements. Host-impact clauses do not grant host delivery.

Synchronous creation captures same-store cutoff/receipts across Models; waiting starts no auth/logout and cannot abort started rotation. No default30s wait,256-key admission cap or ADC60s total budget; caller cancellation/optional deadline governs waiting only. Report all captured outcomes/pending honestly, retain unknown receipts and late-write fences, and keep runtime/crash/cross-process limits explicit. No account fallback/keychain/generic shutdown dependency. Related active V and current source/RDF qualify complete acceptance, host references remain excluded.

Own atomic credential+metadata updates/ACK and receipts at shared store, started rotation survives waiter cancellation while host runtime lives. Synchronous barrier creation captures same-store cutoff across Models, reports every pending/unknown/failure and late-write fence without starting auth or aborting rotation. Network15s scope excludes lock and ACK, no default wait/receipt caps. Serialize login/logout/replace/refresh, preserve host keychain/locking policy and unknown crash/runtime outcomes; migrate existing product bridge coherently.

Observable result and failure: 无 anchor 按 message 合计 UTF-16 units 后 **ceil(chars/3.5)**；350→100、3500→1000，4800 image chars 及 system render/tool 数组各自粒度按固定 corpus。正 reported total 优先，否则仅完整已知正 parent 和；unknown 不补 0、不双加 child、total≠sum 保留；有效成功 anchor＋trailing，不限同 model、不 max 全文、prefix 时间戳失效/Error/Aborted 不 anchor。simple 精确 M/C/F/B′、4096/min1、显式 max 不再 min modelcap；common 1024/2048/8192/16384 家族/极小 ceiling 的 Claude zero按Anthropic truthy fallback1024/Bedrock `??`区分、Chat zero省略，不新增BudgetInsufficient；Google/Vertex 独立表，Pi Messages simple/native 仅转发六个白名单字段，省略max/cache保省略（仅显式long环境覆盖），显式max原值，无通用clamp/default；metadata/sampling/thinkingBudgets/deferred不进envelope。native 不套 simple clamp，逐 wire omission/default/gating/floor；两入口只在 effective 输入等价时比较。sampling/tiers/input limits 见 V-54。必要 API consumer 复用 estimator，产品 compaction/UI 重新设计不计 gate. Apply all source row evidence boundaries and later backend/RDF refinements. Host-impact clauses do not grant host delivery.
verification: cargo test -p opi-ai --test context_budget --test model_wire_metadata --test usage_cost

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: SDK estimator/native/simple preparation; budget. MUST use the last applicable positive successful usage anchor and trailing canonical estimates with the retained unknown/total rules, prefix timestamp invalidation and no same-model/full-text lower bound. Estimate UTF-16 units and 4800 image-equivalent chars with ceil(chars/3.5) at message granularity. Simple uses the annex 4096/min1 and adapter formulas; numeric-Claude zero handling stays wire-qualified instead of adding BudgetInsufficient. Native retains exact wire omission/default/gating without a second global clamp. Related active V and current source/RDF qualify complete acceptance, host references remain excluded.
verification: cargo test -p opi-ai --test context_budget --test model_wire_metadata --test usage_cost

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: Replace estimator with applicable positive successful usage-anchor plus trailing canonical message estimates, UTF16 units/4800image chars/ceil(chars/3.5), prefix invalidation and independent reported totals. Preserve exact native omission/gating and source simple formulas including pi-messages bypass. Modelbase < effective-level < request sampling, tiers strict-threshold/first-equal and service-tier differences are actually wired, OpenRouterimage uses base cost exception. Metadata does not create new predispatch limits, unknown stays distinct from0 and old duplicate reasoning_effort config keys error only after replacement proof. Local scope: public estimator and metadata/cost helpers plus the currently migrated Chat/Responses adapters prove the single arithmetic and precedence mechanism. Full per-adapter service-tier/image pricing and AIR-062/V-54 close at 20.34 after their real adapters.
